quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with this signal, you should:

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to other drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and stay stopped while the red arrow is on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and stay stopped while the red arrow is on.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must stop completely. Do not turn. Stay stopped until the red arrow is gone.

questions.question: A sign with this shape means:
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of danger in work areas.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is near. Slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: When you approach an octagonal (eight-sided) sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Proceed when safe.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass (for example, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that road work is ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to a fork in the road. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only" below it, you should:

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to move in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you must turn left.

questions.question: Signs with orange backgrounds are:
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roadways where you are not allowed to enter. You may see it on expressway ramps you are trying to enter in the wrong direction.

questions.question: This sign indicates:

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn about upcoming hazards. Construction areas are usually marked with orange warning signs.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It tells you to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: This bicyclist is signaling:
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. A bicyclist puts their left arm straight out to signal a left turn.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection. Check all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: This sign tells a driver that:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles and red flags to direct traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is displayed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: A red sign prohibits an action. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Allow space for drivers to merge safely into traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Allow space for drivers to merge safely into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you to merging traffic. Check your sides and rear. Move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is used for work zone signs. This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Obey the flagger's directions.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: One lane is ending soon. Traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending soon. Traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that one lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and check in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and protect your brakes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of curves ahead. The road will curve right first, then left. Adjust your speed safely.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed appropriately.

questions.question: A sign with this shape means:
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path. Stop if necessary.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Begin to slow down.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of sharp curves ahead. The road will turn sharply right first, then sharply left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits or license plates.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign is a regulatory sign that you must obey. Do not pass for any reason.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you to drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: A five-sided sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns of a school zone. It may indicate crosswalks where children are present.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the rear of a vehicle shows it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, construction vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It appears orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means stop.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, you should:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates a divided highway is beginning. Keep to the right.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles such as farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down because it takes longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make U-turns. You may see this sign at intersections where it would be unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield. Let other traffic go first.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may enter your lane from the right side. Be ready for this.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other traffic pass first. You don't always need to stop, but you must be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Round yellow warning signs are only used for railroad crossings. Be prepared to stop for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you traffic will merge from the right side. Be ready to make room.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Change lanes or move into position carefully.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you go.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing without a signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if you see or hear one. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a side road is coming. Stay alert for traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with a traffic light shows that a traffic signal is coming. Be prepared to stop or slow down.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are always ordered with red at the top, yellow in the middle, and green at the bottom.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road is coming ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to make room.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with curves ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let other traffic pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming ahead.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs show motorist services like rest areas, food, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. It is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: When displayed on the rear of a vehicle, what does this sign indicate?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This emblem warns other drivers that the vehicle moves at 25 mph or slower, such as farm equipment or bicycles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a right turn arrow with a slash through it. Turning right is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to move to the right of an island or barrier. The highway ahead is divided.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you to slow down for a sharp turn ahead. Be ready to change direction quickly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn here. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road direction changes sharply or the road narrows. You may see it on curves or bridge approaches.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a crosswalk ahead. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign forbids right turns. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mean construction is happening. Proceed with caution and watch for workers and equipment.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns you are near a school. Be alert for children and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign tells you a school zone is ahead. Be aware of children and follow speed limits.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You don't need to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells slower drivers to stay in the right lane. This keeps the left lane open for faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the median.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign. You must stop completely. Do not proceed until the way is clear.

questions.question: What type of thing does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you an intersection is ahead. Be ready for traffic or to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve ahead with a suggested speed. Slow to 35 mph or less for the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of two-way traffic ahead. Be careful of traffic coming from both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. Left turns are prohibited here.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then curves left. Be ready for both curves.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some yellow warning signs have a bright green background. This sign warns of a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you traffic is coming from both directions ahead. You are leaving a one-way road.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You may turn left only on a green arrow.
You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
You must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A sign that says "yield" means slow down and be ready to stop. After yielding, you may follow the remaining directions on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot turn right or left when the light is red. Wait for a green light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns that wet roads are slippery. Be careful and reduce speed in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake damage.
